definitions.explanation: An area of grass that is kept mowed, typically in a garden or park.

notes:
{芝生|しばふ} refers to a lawn or grassed area, typically maintained (mowed).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {芝生|しばふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ (to mow the lawn)
- {芝生|しばふ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝転|ねころ}ぶ→寝転ぶ：04643_nekorobu⟧ (to lie on the grass)
- {芝生|しばふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧ (lawn maintenance)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芝生|しばふ}⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧ (grassy plaza/square)
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧⟦{芝|しば}→芝：19341_shiba⟧ (artificial turf)
- ⟦{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}→芝刈り機：17028_shibakariki⟧ (lawn mower)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {芝生|しばふ}: lawn, maintained grass area
- ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧: grass (general, uncut)
